clips.title: The story
paras: Near Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore, the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler holds foul water drawn from the headwaters. The Cenarion Circle needs it to study the sickness striking local deer.

Cliffspring Falls feeds much of Darkshore with water from the eastern highlands. Local deer have recently fallen ill with an unnatural sickness. At Dendrite Starblaze’s request in Moonglade, druidic initiates draw water from a cave mouth where hostile naga dwell. The liquid in the vial is visibly foul, showing that the fresh water supply is tainted.
